title: Roasted Garlic Mashed Potato
subtitle: Buttery mashed potato with sweet, slow-roasted garlic
excerpt: Roasting a whole head of garlic transforms it from sharp and pungent to sweet and spreadable. Squeezed into the mash, it adds depth without any raw garlic harshness. This is the mash to make when you want to impress.
sourceNotes: Roasted garlic mash is a modern British bistro classic, drawing on the French tradition of pommes puree enriched with butter and cream.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Roast the garlic up to 3 days ahead. Keep in the fridge until needed.
recipe.temperatureNote: Fan 180C / Gas 6. For roasting the garlic.

content.text: Drain the potatoes very thoroughly before mashing. Any water left in the potato will make the mash waterlogged, no matter how much butter you add.

items.prepNote: floury variety such as Maris Piper, peeled and cut into chunks
top 1cm sliced off to expose the cloves

content.text: Preheat the oven. Place the garlic head cut-side up in the roasting tin. Drizzle with a little olive oil. Roast for 35 to 40 minutes until the cloves are golden and completely soft.
While the garlic roasts, cook the potatoes in well-salted boiling water for 15 to 18 minutes until completely tender.
Drain the potatoes thoroughly. Return them to the warm saucepan over low heat for 1 minute to steam off any remaining water.
Squeeze the roasted garlic cloves from their skins into the pan with the potatoes.
Add the butter and mash until smooth. Pour in the warm cream and beat until fluffy. Season generously with salt and white pepper.

items.symptom: The mash is gluey and sticky.
items.cause: The potatoes were over-worked or blended instead of mashed.
items.fix: Use a masher or ricer; never use a food processor for potato.

items.cause: The potatoes were not drained and dried thoroughly.
items.fix: Return drained potatoes to the dry pan over low heat for 2 minutes.

items.symptom: The garlic flavour is too mild.
items.cause: The garlic was not roasted long enough.
items.fix: Roast until every clove is completely golden and soft throughout.
